svg.title: Two layers of the same decision: which effort does this task get?
svg.desc: Top row, inside developer tools: a coding task goes to HydraFusion, which picks a Single, Cascade or Critique workflow and returns one reviewed change set. Bottom row, built into your own systems: a ticket, alert or tool call goes to a decision model, which returns a calibrated probability. The result is acted on at 0.9 or above, sent to a person between 0.6 and 0.9, or rejected below 0.6, and every decision is written to an audit log.
